lines.en: I chamber a round as I walk.

lines.zh: 野猪蹄踏着碎石追上来。
lines.en: My boar hooves clatter after you on the gravel.

lines.zh: 枪击声响起，你无处可逃！
火器的声音就是我的食物！
蹄子踩着碎石，枪口朝前。
lines.en: Hooves crunch gravel, muzzle pointed ahead.

lines.zh: 腐烂的獠牙间还叼着弹壳。
lines.en: A spent casing is still clamped in my rotting tusks.
Prey, I won't let you go...

lines.zh: 枪声中等待死亡的到来...

lines.en: Barrel still hot, but my arm won't lift.

lines.zh: 饥肠辘辘的你，成了我的午餐！

lines.en: Don't try to run! I got a gun.
Rotten flesh on the wind, from over there.

lines.zh: 我的枪比你的剑更致命！
lines.en: My gun's deadlier than your sword.

lines.zh: 我抬起枪口，对准你胸口。
lines.en: I raise the muzzle to your chest.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道从你背包里来。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh comes from your pack.

lines.zh: 腐肉和野猪弹，都是我的战利品！
lines.en: 腐肉和野猪弹, my trophies.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我腰间的弹袋。
lines.en: You bump the ammo pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我！现在受苦吧！
你撞上了我！现在倒下吧！
lines.en: You bumped into me! Now fall!

lines.zh: 我的獠牙离你只有半格。
lines.en: My tusks are half a block from you.
Two muzzles, one left and one right.
Boar rounds and gold nuggets, I keep both.

lines.zh: 金粒滚落，我用舌头卷了起来。
lines.en: Gold nuggets roll loose, and I scoop them up with my tongue.
Hog rounds — made for the living.

lines.zh: 枪管发烫，我还是扣扳机。
lines.en: The barrel's hot — I still pull the trigger.
Grave dust rises off my shoulder.
Ash still smokes from my muzzle.

lines.zh: 枪口抬起，我闻到活人的味道。
lines.en: The muzzle comes up. I smell a living man.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，我就换个角度。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree. I change my angle.

lines.zh: 獠牙和扳机，同时对准你。
lines.en: Tusks and trigger both point at you.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，我抬起了枪。
lines.en: You snap a branch, and my gun comes up.
A round is chambered. You haven't gone far.

lines.zh: 这只猪的眼睛，一直跟着你。
lines.en: This boar's eye has never left you.

lines.zh: 远处的脚步，让我拨开草丛。
lines.en: Footsteps in the distance make me part the grass.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在风里，我听得清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing rides the wind. I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 腐肉味的野猪弹，装好了。

lines.en: Barrel up — I'll take your legs first.

lines.zh: 枪管还冒烟，我就换好了弹。
lines.en: My barrel still smokes as I reload.

lines.zh: 别横着跑，我喜欢打移动的。
lines.en: Don't run sideways. I like moving targets.

lines.zh: 先打膝盖，让你跪下来再咬。
lines.en: Knee first, so you kneel and I can bite.

lines.zh: 弹道算好了，倒下的位置也定好了。
lines.en: Trajectory solved. Even where you fall is decided.
One round left. That is enough.

lines.zh: 你转身的瞬间，我扣下扳机。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I pull the trigger.

lines.zh: 枪托抵住肩膀，我稳住呼吸。
lines.en: The stock hits my shoulder, and I steady my breath.
One shot seals your way out.

lines.zh: 别指望掩体，木板挡不住。
lines.en: Don't count on cover. Planks won't stop it.

lines.zh: 这一枪，我留给你的后脑。
lines.en: This shot I keep for the back of your head.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙挑开你的护腿。
lines.en: My tusk rips your leggings open.

lines.zh: 你离我近点，尝尝我的牙齿！
lines.en: Come closer and feel my teeth!

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉，就逃不出我的攻击！
lines.en: Feasting on rot, you can’t escape my attack!

lines.zh: 你的头颅将成为我的战利品！
lines.en: Your head will be my trophy!

lines.zh: 用我的牙齿撕裂你的盔甲！
lines.en: Rip your armor with my teeth!

lines.zh: 腐烂的野猪，咬断你的骨头！
野猪的獠牙，刺穿你的皮肤！
腐化的力量，撕裂你的灵魂！
用我的爪子终结你的生命！
lines.en: End your life with my claws!
My tusks pry your armor open.

lines.zh: 枪托砸下来，比子弹更钝。
lines.en: The gun stock comes down, blunter than a bullet.

lines.zh: 腐肉的气味喷在你脸上。
lines.en: The reek of rotten flesh hits your face.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手腕，扳机归我。
lines.en: I bite your wrist. The trigger is mine now.

lines.zh: 腐烂的舌头舔过你的伤口。
lines.en: My rotting tongue drags over your wound.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，像踩碎的干枝。
lines.en: Bone cracks like a dry twig underfoot.
You fall, and only then do I start eating.
My tusks twist and tear a piece free.

lines.zh: 别叫，会招来更多我的同类。
lines.en: Don't scream. It brings more of my kind.

lines.zh: 腐化的野猪，出没于废墟！
从腐肉堆中爬出的怪物！
废墟塌了一角，我从中钻出。
lines.en: A corner of the ruins caves in, and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 枪先伸出来，然后才是我。
lines.en: The gun comes out first. Then the rest of me.
I fall into mud, still gripping my gun.

lines.zh: 烂肺里灌满了水，咳不出来。
lines.en: Water fills my rotten lungs and I cannot cough it out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的獠牙震松了。
饿得连子弹都咬不动了。
lines.en: I am so starved I cannot even bite a bullet.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙上还挂着菌丝。
lines.en: Fungal threads still hang from my tusks.
